notes.title: Untitled
2P Mode Now Available!
notes.content:
2P Mode Now Available!

2 player mode provides an easy way to experience the thrill of Chainman with a friend. Even a friend that perhaps is more reluctant to enjoy the immersion of VR Horror.

Unlike the single player experience, one player aids the other with the use of a helpful drone, controlled through the PC. The other player plays as usual in first-person using the Virtual Reality headset.
 
· 2 player Local Co-op.
· Player 1 controls a Drone on the PC. Player 2 plays in first-person with the Virtual Reality Headset.
· Locate and repair the generators to activate the door to escape (Only the VR player can repair the generator).
· If the VR player dies, the game is lost.

We hope this mode will enable you to share your love for horror games with those that are usually too afraid to try.

notes.title: Untitled
2P Mode will be released Oct.14 morning(LA time)
notes.content:
Sorry I made you wait. The release date of 2P mode has been decided. It will be the morning of October 14 (Los Angeles time).

You can play with confidence even if you are not afraid of scary games. You let your friends wear HMD and you can enjoy comfortably by operating and instructing with confidence on the monitor.

In 2P mode, the survival factor is stronger than the horror element, and it becomes a more action game

Also 2P mode can be played alone in theory, but it is getting very difficult.
If someone can play brilliantly alone, I would like to watch videos.

notes.title: TGS2017 ＆ Palmer plays 2P mode( local coop mode)
notes.content:
Now we are exhibiting a ChainMan PlayStation VR version at Tokyo Game Show 2017.
It's going to well.

And today Palmer Lucky plays 2P mode.
He dislikes horror games, but 2P players can play with confidence. The 1P player is scary as ever.
